title: fix(console): the profile Language card says it is the same setting as the globe menu
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDHJBvzScLgkhKgms97sNuU)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhoBbwh8URjwQHde8v

Fixes #36971
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 个人资料页「语言」卡片的说明文字改了：以前说它只管通知、界面语言另在地球菜单里设，现在说它和地球菜单是同一项设置，界面和通知都跟着它走；用户无需任何操作。
- 替普通用户解决：两个语言入口早已合并成同一项设置，旧说明会让只想改邮件语言的人把整个控制台也切换掉。
- 只改说明文字和代码注释，不改任何行为；万一某种语言的措辞不自然，直接撤回即可。
- 无。

## What changes

The profile page's Language card told users it only sets the language of notifications and messages, and that the interface language is chosen separately from the globe menu. That has not been true since objectui#10059: both controls write `sys_user.locale`, and the console shell applies that column as the interface language (`useUserLocale` in `@object-ui/app-shell`: the globe writes it through `useLanguageSelection`, and `useSignedInUserLocale` applies it on every `sys_user` mutation, the card's own save included). Premise verified in code on `origin/main` 144d368eac1 before editing.

- `profile.language.description` now says it is ONE setting, for the interface and for the notifications and messages sent to the user, the same one as the globe menu, so changing one changes the other.
  - English: "The language of the interface and of the notifications and messages sent to you. It is the same setting as the globe menu, so changing one changes the other."
  - zh-Hans: 「界面以及发送给您的通知和消息所使用的语言。它与地球图标菜单是同一项设置，更改其中一处，另一处也会随之更改。」 (full-width punctuation; the old string's half-width comma is gone).
- The key lives in **all ten** built-in packs, not only en and zh-Hans as the dispatch read assumed: en, zh-Hans, ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru were rewritten by hand, and zh-Hant was regenerated from zh-Hans with `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` (only that one line moved).
- The console's own fallback text (the `defaultValue` at the card's call site) carries the same English sentence.
- The `LanguageCard` component comment no longer says the two are separate and "deliberately not touched"; it states the unified behaviour and points at `useUserLocale` / objectui#10059.
- One changeset: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`, both patch (both are published; neither is private).

The save-confirmation sites in the same file (the `saved` state and its success `Alert`s) are untouched; they belong to #36972, which is in flight on its own branch. `overlap-check` is clean, and a `git merge-tree` against that branch's head 3147c224723 merges cleanly.

## Tests

Tests (final head be2c5211766): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/ apps/console/src/pages/system/__tests__/ProfilePage` (115 files, 2072 passed, 13 skipped); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (172 files passed, 2 skipped); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check` (both exit 0; the new test file is in the console's tsc program).

New pin, a top-level `describe` in the existing harness `ProfilePage.language.test.tsx`: the rendered card description says it is the same setting as the globe menu, mentions the interface, does not say "separately", and equals the English pack's `profile.language.description`, so the call-site fallback and the pack cannot drift apart again.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (two legs, from the committed fix, via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

- Leg 1: put the old sentence back into the card's fallback text. Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob a489b18f19d5 to 31b8a1633e35). The new case went red: `expected 'The language used for notifications a…' to match /same setting as the globe menu/`, 1 failed and 12 passed. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Leg 2: put the old second sentence back into the English pack only. Mutation landed (blob 992eeef095da to 9d99b5fb5715). The new case went red on the equality with the pack, 1 failed and 12 passed. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

No dist build is in this path: the console's vitest aliases `@object-ui/i18n` to its source.
</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 41 families for this diff. All 41 ran locally and exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "41 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero, all 41 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Also run: `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations) and `check-nul-bytes` (exit 0). Every other CI family is left to this PR's check-runs.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch said only en and zh-Hans carry the key. In fact all ten packs do (the other packs translate the sentence, so an English grep misses them). The dispatch's own instruction for that case ("change them too") was followed.
- The non-English, non-Chinese rewrites (ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru) were written by the agent. A native-speaker read is welcome, but each one says the same three things as the English.
- Follow-up: none.

## Verification

Read first: the `profile.language.description` line in the en and zh-Hans packs, then the rewritten "One setting with the globe menu" section of the `LanguageCard` doc comment in `ProfilePage.tsx` (the only hunk that states behaviour).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/__tests__/ProfilePage.language.test.tsx`. Expected: 13 passed, including "says the globe menu is the same setting, not a separate interface language". In a running console, open Account → Profile. The Language card now says it is the same setting as the globe menu.
